run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum characters between two identical characters in a string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple string inputs to verify correct maximum distance calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the widest gap between matching character pairs in a string
review_f_gold: review f_gold for its O(n^2) nested loop approach to finding repeated character distances
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map for O(n) lookup of first character positions
